shared_elements: horizontal band or arc spanning the surface
justification: Both are weathered stone surfaces worked in shallow relief with rounded, bulging forms and each carries a broad horizontal band or arc plus small disc-like elements, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A is an unmistakable narrative frieze of repeated human figures with raised arms marching along a curved rectangular panel, whereas B is a monolithic upright block whose back bears isolated, non-narrative geometric and abstract motifs distributed vertically over a much larger, coarser field.
